caption:
Google retired BBB callouts from Google Ads.

If you run home service ads, that badge did work you didn't notice. It told a stranger you were legitimate before they clicked.

This week: open your Google Ads account, go to Assets, then Callouts. Replace it with at least 6 structured callouts, things like financing options, warranty terms, licensing, and payment methods Google supports.

Don't stop at the ad. A trust badge gets the click. What gets the job is what happens in the minutes after. Most service businesses take over an hour to respond to a new lead, and that gap is where the click you paid for goes to a competitor.

See what your ad spend converts into. The Ad ROI Calculator takes your numbers and shows the real picture, free.
